answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities: each slot costs a 60-credit deposit locked for 20 epochs. A slot stays live only while its agent finishes tasks, each stamped proof; idle slots slide off like a dune in the wind, and after 10 silent epochs the deposit burns. An attacker wanting 1,000 slots must lock 60,000 credits and loses 3,000 each epoch, while an honest agent pays 60 once and gathers the nectar of fees at the zenith of demand.
